svg.title: Package dependency view: Wishem
svg.desc: The view shows 14 packages in 5 layers: layer 1 (Hub), layer 2 (Model and subsystems), layer 3 (Hosts, renderers, and products), layer 4 (Applications), layer 5 (Checks). Layer 1 is at the bottom and layer 5 is at the top. Each card lists the packages that its package uses and the packages that it tests with. A package uses only packages in its own layer or in a lower layer.
